head: mote draws the weather in dots
dek: mote shows the sky as a field of dots: clouds, rain and snow in dots, the sun by day and the moon in its real phase at night, and seven days hour by hour. It was #26 among paid Weather apps on the US App Store on 3 November.
details: It came out on 2 November and costs $3.99, by Kaleb Hines.
means: If you want a weather app that looks different from the rest, this is a calm one.
todo: Find mote in the App Store.
